request.description: Standard crawl request. When headless mode is enabled for navigable pages, CrawlSharp returns rendered HTML in WebResource.Data.

body.raw:
{
  "Authentication": {
    "Type": "None"
  },
  "Crawl": {
    "UserAgent": "CrawlSharp",
    "StartUrl": "https://alexnogle.com",
    "UseHeadlessBrowser": false,
    "AutoExpandCollapsibles": false,
    "PostLoadDelayMs": 0,
    "PostInteractionDelayMs": 250,
    "MaxExpansionPasses": 2,
    "ExpansionSelectors": [],
    "IgnoreRobotsText": false,
    "IncludeSitemap": true,
    "FollowLinks": true,
    "FollowRedirects": true,
    "MaxRedirects": 10,
    "RestrictToChildUrls": false,
    "RestrictToSameSubdomain": false,
    "RestrictToSameRootDomain": true,
    "AllowedDomains": [],
    "DeniedDomains": [],
    "MaxCrawlDepth": 2,
    "ExcludeLinkPatterns": [],
    "FollowExternalLinks": true,
    "MaxParallelTasks": 16,
    "PageTimeoutMs": 30000,
    "ThrottleMs": 5000,
    "RetryOn429": true,
    "MaxRetries": 3,
    "RetryMinBackoffMs": 1000,
    "RetryMaxBackoffMs": 30000,
    "RetryBackoffJitter": true,
    "RequestDelayMs": 2500
  }
}

request.description: Opt-in headless crawl that expands common collapsible content before HTML capture. Expansion settings are ignored unless UseHeadlessBrowser is true.

body.raw:
{
  "Authentication": {
    "Type": "None"
  },
  "Crawl": {
    "UserAgent": "CrawlSharp",
    "StartUrl": "https://example.com",
    "UseHeadlessBrowser": true,
    "AutoExpandCollapsibles": true,
    "PostLoadDelayMs": 500,
    "PostInteractionDelayMs": 250,
    "MaxExpansionPasses": 2,
    "ExpansionSelectors": [
      ".faq-toggle"
    ],
    "IgnoreRobotsText": false,
    "IncludeSitemap": true,
    "FollowLinks": true,
    "FollowRedirects": true,
    "MaxRedirects": 10,
    "RestrictToChildUrls": false,
    "RestrictToSameSubdomain": false,
    "RestrictToSameRootDomain": true,
    "AllowedDomains": [],
    "DeniedDomains": [],
    "MaxCrawlDepth": 2,
    "ExcludeLinkPatterns": [],
    "FollowExternalLinks": true,
    "MaxParallelTasks": 16,
    "PageTimeoutMs": 30000,
    "ThrottleMs": 5000,
    "RetryOn429": true,
    "MaxRetries": 3,
    "RetryMinBackoffMs": 1000,
    "RetryMaxBackoffMs": 30000,
    "RetryBackoffJitter": true,
    "RequestDelayMs": 2500
  }
}

request.description: Crawl a site that requires credentials. Set Authentication.Type to Basic, ApiKey or BearerToken and supply that type's fields (the values here come from the collection variables). Credentials are sent only to the start URL's origin, its HTTPS version when the start URL is plain HTTP, and any origins in CredentialOrigins; they are re-attached to same-origin redirect targets and never sent to other origins. The crawler follows redirects itself, up to MaxRedirects hops, and stops redirect loops after one pass. Incomplete authentication settings return 400 Bad Request.

body.raw:
{
  "Authentication": {
    "Type": "Basic",
    "Username": "{{authUsername}}",
    "Password": "{{authPassword}}",
    "CredentialOrigins": []
  },
  "Crawl": {
    "UserAgent": "CrawlSharp",
    "StartUrl": "{{authStartUrl}}",
    "UseHeadlessBrowser": false,
    "IgnoreRobotsText": false,
    "IncludeSitemap": true,
    "FollowLinks": true,
    "FollowRedirects": true,
    "MaxRedirects": 10,
    "RestrictToChildUrls": true,
    "RestrictToSameSubdomain": true,
    "RestrictToSameRootDomain": true,
    "MaxCrawlDepth": 2,
    "FollowExternalLinks": false,
    "MaxParallelTasks": 4,
    "PageTimeoutMs": 30000,
    "RequestDelayMs": 2500
  }
}
